items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I was just a sub for Sammy, it was only ten days with Duke, I subbed for Sammy.

ctx.x: I was just a sub for Sammy, it was only ten days with Duke, I subbed for Sammy.
Now you made a comment that you felt you didn’t play good with Ellington ‘cause you were listening too hard.

No I didn’t play well with that thing, no, I didn’t play well at all with that. Especially when Duke was conducting. He goes like this you know. He looked like a knuckle ball © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
